attributes.name: content block arrangement
attributes.definition: How secondary content sections lower on the page are arranged relative to each other: stacked vertically or placed side by side.

values.definition: Sections each span the full width and are stacked vertically, often with alternating backgrounds.
Content blocks or cards sit next to each other horizontally in a row or grid.
Combination of stacked and side-by-side arrangements.

attributes.name: section background treatment
attributes.definition: How successive content sections are differentiated by background fill.

values.definition: Full-width sections alternate between white and a light gray/tint.
A promo or feature is set in a dark-filled card against a lighter surround.
Sections share a single background with no alternation.
